# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen in fourth book; adult  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor  <sub>[v4 c9 P56](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0056)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a tall, broad-shouldered fellow with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a broad, frank face. He is described as handsome, carrying himself with straightforward charm and a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is frank, cheerful, determined, and popular. He possesses a strong sense of personal honor and high ideals, guarding his words and actions carefully. Though teasing as a youth, he is mature, supportive, and dedicated to his profession as a doctor.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v4 c20 P1](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0001)_

## History

Gilbert returned to Avonlea after spending three years in Alberta due to his father's illness. On his return to school, he tried to get Anne Shirley's attention by pulling her braid and calling her 'Carrots', sparking an intense academic rivalry that lasted for years. Despite Anne snubbing his early attempts to reconcile, Gilbert continued to harbor deep affection for her while excelling at Avonlea School. He went on to attend Redmond College in Kingsport, where he served as Freshman Class president, led his class to victory in the annual Arts Rush, and joined the 'Lambs' fraternity. During his college years, he suffered a severe bout of typhoid fever at home in Avonlea, which ultimately brought about Anne's realization of her love for him. After finishing his education and becoming a doctor, Gilbert married Anne, and the couple established their home at Four Winds Point.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 c40 P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v4 c9 P56](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0056), [v4 c20 P1](../source/v04-c20.md#nw-v04-c20-p0001)_
